'''Donald Snider First Rebellion (Fun)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Donald Snider]]
* '''Published:''' May 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' First Rebellion (Fun)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE First Rebellion (Fun) Snider LS 1999.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

'''Intro:''':

I created this deck for fun. The idea being that the Rebel Alliance has not been formed yet. The Ishi Tibs have had enough of Imperial Control and have recruited the 'peace-loving' Ithorians to help them out.

== Strategy ==

The strategy of the deck is to get the characters out as quickly as possible, and use the operatives to help you Force drain your opponent into coming to fight you. The side-strategy is to have Tessek, Momaw Nadon and Shasa Tiel hang out at the Audience Chamber with Bo Shuda, protected by Uh-Oh, which was out at the start of the game using The Signal.

All of your Ithorians and Ishi Tibs would then be deploy -1, power +2, forfeit +2 and add 1 to force drains, and that is before the objective is completed. Once the objective is completed, the operatives become a force on their own. Incom Engineer + 8D8 helps your starfighters (they aren't rebel fighters -- the Incom design team defected to Tibrin instead). Average destiny is 3.
